title: Not as sturdy as I expected. Not adjustable. Doesn't accommodate boots.
text: Not as sturdy as I expected. Not adjustable. Doesn't accommodate boots.. Not very sturdy.  It would be nice if it was adjustable or if I could remove a shelf to fit boots, but it's not.  I think it's kind of cheaply made.  I say this is definitely not a good value @ $40
